_comment: The second sentence of a reading: which part of the chart was struck.
Seven natal bodies by five tones, 35 clauses.
This is the dimension that turns one area's reading into seven. The area
says WHERE in a life it lands; this says WHICH PART OF YOU took it. They
are written to sit after the body sentence in readings.json and before the
timing clause in motion.json, so any of the 120 openings can be followed
by any of these and then by any of the 14 timings.

sun.charged: Your sense of yourself is doing the reacting, which is why it feels personal.
sun.open: Your sense of yourself is the part with room in it today.
sun.friction: It is your sense of yourself under the pressure, so it will read as criticism even where none is meant.
sun.easy: Your sense of yourself is steady underneath it, which is why none of this costs much.
sun.pull: Your sense of yourself is on one end of this and something else is on the other.

moon.charged: It is landing on your mood rather than your judgement, and mood always arrives first.
moon.open: What you need is easier to say than usual today, and easier to hear.
moon.friction: It is your need for things to be settled that is taking the strain.
moon.easy: Your footing is good, so you can afford to feel the whole of it.
moon.pull: What you need and what is being asked of you are at opposite ends of this.

mercury.charged: It is landing on how you put things, so the wording matters more today than the point.
mercury.open: The words are the part that has room in them today.
mercury.friction: It is your way of putting things under strain, not what you actually mean by them.
mercury.easy: The talking is the easy part today, which is not always true.
mercury.pull: What you want to say and what wants saying are pulling in different directions.

venus.charged: It is landing on what you want, which is why it will not stay quiet.
venus.open: What you are drawn to is unusually within reach today.
venus.friction: It is what you want that is under strain, and wanting has never been a plan.
venus.easy: What you want and what is available are close together today.
venus.pull: What you want is on one side of this and what you already have is on the other.

mars.charged: It is landing on your drive, which is why it will present itself as urgency.
mars.open: The push is available today without having to be forced.
mars.friction: It is your drive taking the resistance, which is why it reads as frustration.
mars.easy: The effort goes in cleanly today, which is not the usual rate of exchange.
mars.pull: Your pace and somebody else's are at opposite ends of this.

jupiter.charged: It is landing on the part of you that wants more, and that part is not subtle.
jupiter.open: The room to grow is genuinely there today rather than imagined.
jupiter.friction: It is your appetite for more being checked, and the check is a fair one.
jupiter.easy: Growth costs less than usual today, so it is worth spending on.
jupiter.pull: Wanting more and holding steady are at opposite ends of this.

saturn.charged: It is landing on the part of you that carries things, and that part is already tired.
saturn.open: The structure you have been needing is unusually easy to put in place today.
saturn.friction: It is the part of you that carries things taking the weight, which is why it feels heavy.
saturn.easy: The discipline is available today without costing what it usually costs.
saturn.pull: What is owed and what is wanted are at opposite ends of this.
